text:
Geneva Watch Auction XXIV, held with Bacs & Russo on 7-8 November, sold for US$112.3 million. All 217 lots offered were sold, and the sale set 24 world records.

The top lot was Lot 7, a platinum F.P. Journe Chronomètre à Résonance 'Régence', which sold for CHF 8,680,500.

Prices include buyer's premium, as reported by Phillips.

Would you bid on the Régence? Tell us in the comments.

Source: Phillips, Geneva Watch Auction XXIV results (7-8 Nov 2026); The Watchology.
